728-2033-3249-6112--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing Volrath to become a copy of Glider Bairn until end of turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, proliferating all the counters on target permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-3200-4986-6495.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2866-3200-4986-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3532-4030-5078-7864.description:

Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1594-3330-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Leyline of Vitality trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-3330-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-6927-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Damage Control Crew
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Resolve the Lithatog ability.

Repeat.

997-4311-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
997-4311-4871-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

11-4084-6555-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-4084-6555-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Part the Waterveil by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Part the Waterveil.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Part the Waterveil spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Part the Waterveil spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Part the Waterveil and returning the original Part the Waterveil to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Part the Waterveil from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

539-2783-3967-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.

Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spark Double.

Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.
3908-5330-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

Resolve the Curious Forager trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.

"Myr" chosen with Urza's Incubator.

 At the beginning of your combat phase, Urtet's second ability triggers, untapping all Myr you control.
